brief:
Families in Nuseirat camp spent the night without shelter after an Israeli army operation forced them to leave their homes, Al Jazeera English reported. Many residents remain fearful of returning to their neighborhoods despite Israel announcing an end to the offensive in the area.

The displacement adds to the humanitarian toll in Gaza, where civilians have repeatedly been forced to evacuate during military operations. Residents expressed concern about safety conditions and the viability of returning to damaged or destroyed housing.
dek: Families in Nuseirat spend the night without shelter, while many fear returning despite Israel ending offensive.
title: Israeli operation displaces Gaza families from homes
